info.title: Property AI Studio (PropVista CRM) API
info.description: REST API for PropVista CRM. Base path /api/v1. JWT Bearer auth. Gemini-only AI. Roles: customer, agent, admin, super_admin. Guest = no auth. Errors: {error:{code,message,details[]}}. Pagination meta. Prices as strings. Notification channels: email, in_app.
